news.headline: PSX: KSE-100 settles below 177,000 as US-Iran conflict escalates, oil surges
news.summary: Supersedes the already-logged Aug 31, 2026 11:45am DPS intraday checkpoint (177,962.64, +266.14pts/+0.15%, MACRO only). KSE-100 confirmed close Mon Aug 31, 2026 at 176,975.68, down 720.83 points (-0.41%) from Friday Aug 28's confirmed close of 177,696.50 (already logged); intraday high 178,138.69, low 176,944.91; volume 937.2m shares, value Rs39.1bn, per Business Recorder ('PSX: KSE-100 settles below 177,000 level amid US-Iran conflict') and The Express Tribune. news.headline: PSX: KSE-100 falls nearly 1% amid geopolitical tensions as US-Iran conflict escalates
news.summary: KSE-100 confirmed close Wed Sept 2, 2026 at 174,776.60, down 1,690.40 points (-0.96%) from Tue Sept 1's confirmed close of 176,466.99 (already logged); intraday high 175,841.83, low 174,562.88, per Business Recorder. Selling driven by supply-disruption concerns after the US and Iran exchanged strikes overnight, a continuation of the already-logged Aug 31 US-Iran conflict shock. Sectors trading red: automobile assemblers, cement, commercial banks, oil & gas exploration, OMCs, power generation; index-heavy stocks named trading red: HUBCO (HUBC), MARI, OGDC, PPL, HBL, MCB, MEBL and NBP. news.headline: SECP issues final notices in Unity Foods unusual-trading probe; probe tied to separate FIA criminal case over alleged multi-billion-rupee irregularities
news.summary: SECP issued final notices on Sept 2, 2026 to four individuals - CEO Muhammad Farrukh, Safdar Sajjad, Fehmida Amin and Hina Safdar - requiring them to appear before its Karachi investigation team on Sept 3, 2026, after they neither appeared nor requested rescheduling from an Aug 31 summons, per ProPakistani. The formal SECP investigation (opened June 2, 2026 under Section 139 of the Securities Act 2015) covers alleged unusual/insider trading in Unity Foods Limited (PSX: UNITY) shares; Farrukh is specifically required to explain and provide records on the pledging of UNITY shares with banks. Per search-indexed reporting (ProPakistani, Business Recorder, TechJuice headlines), this SECP probe separately led to an FIA criminal case (around Aug 31, 2026) against Unity Foods' former management over alleged multi-billion-rupee financial irregularities; one search result cited a discrepancy of about Rs44.7bn between published accounts and internal records, not independently confirmed via a directly-fetched primary article this cycle. No PSX trading halt/suspension of UNITY shares reported in sources checked. Logged as impact 5 (severe - fraud/criminal-case allegations, default per desk criteria Rule 10); escalation flagged.

news.headline: Pakistan raises record $3bn through largest-ever dual-tranche Eurobond sale
news.summary: Pakistan raised $3 billion through a dual-tranche Eurobond sale announced Sept 3, 2026 - $1.75bn via a 5.5-year bond at a 7.5% coupon and $1.25bn via a 10-year bond at 7.9% - drawing nearly $6bn in orders (almost double the amount issued) from a broad, diversified base of institutional investors, per Business Recorder, ProPakistani, Dawn.com and Aaj English TV. Described as Pakistan's largest-ever single international bond issuance; proceeds earmarked for external financing needs including debt repayments. This confirms/upgrades the already-logged Aug 25, 2026 item ('Pakistan eyes $1-2bn return to global capital markets', impact 3) from a pending plan to a completed, priced transaction of larger size. Logged as impact 4 (material - confirmed major sovereign financing deal / sharp positive macro-financing development, per desk criteria Rule 10); escalation flagged.
